svg.aria-label: How it works, the cold read: a section picture has its words cut away, only the picture goes to a blind reader who never saw the project, the reader writes what it shows, and that answer is held against the claim in claims.json: it matches, so the picture passes; a miss would send it back to be redrawn.
svg.text: Each picture faces a stranger first
Its words are cut away. If the reader misses, it is redrawn.

g.text: It asks a few questions, once.
